# Platform icon sources

The bundled PNGs are local, 128px application-icon snapshots used only to
identify the corresponding platform inside Alpha-Nexus. They were obtained on
2026-07-24 from the public Apple App Store artwork exposed by the verified
publisher listing for each platform (China storefront; TikTok uses the United
States storefront where the official listing is available).

`xhs`, `kuaishou`, and `wechat_video` were already bundled as their official
platform marks. `custom` intentionally has no asset: it represents a user
defined destination, not a third-party platform.

These marks remain the property of their respective owners and are not used to
imply endorsement.

The e-commerce console marks (`douyin_shop`, `taobao`, `tiktok_shop`,
`shopee`, `shopify`, and `amazon_seller`) are local PNG conversions of the
favicon served by each official login or seller-console host, retrieved on
2026-08-01. No application icon was generated.

The remaining e-commerce marks were completed on 2026-08-30. `alibaba_1688`,
`aliexpress`, `jd_shop`, `qianchuan`, and `xianyu` are local PNG conversions of
favicons served by the corresponding official sites (`work.1688.com`,
`aliexpress.com`, `jfe-lb.jd.com`, ByteDance's Qianchuan CDN, and
`goofish.com`). Store variants for Pinduoduo, Xiaohongshu, Kuaishou, and WeChat
reuse the already bundled official brand artwork for the same platform.
